Method of Attack: DDoS-for-hire service used to launch large-scale DDoS cyberattacks
aiding and abetting unlawful computer intrusions and attempted unlawful computer intrusions
Date of Discovery: December 20, 2018 (seizure of Quantum Stresser and other booter sites)
Impacted Systems: Victim networks worldwide including Alaska and California
US companies and government assets (WebStresser users targeted)
Victims of DDoS attacks launched by Quantum Stresser and WebStresser
Attack Vector: Subscription-based access to DDoS attack services
Indicators of Compromise: More than 80,000 customer subscriptions on Quantum Stresser as of November 29, 2018
WebStresser had 151,000 registered users when taken down in April 2018
Public service announcements and victim notifications issued by DoJ and FBI
